name: Performance
author: pelicaninstaller
description: Node-aware performance advisor: detects each server's workload (PaperMC, Forge/NeoForge/Fabric/Quilt, Pumpkin, Source engine, Python, Node.js, proxies) and recommends tuned startup flags, correct memory sizing (fixes unbounded JVM heaps), server.properties / pumpkin.toml / user_jvm_args optimizations, JVM boot accelerators (CDS, Java 25 AOT cache), a platform advisor and a server-side optimizer-mod bundle (ModernFix, FerriteCore, ...) matched to the exact loader and Minecraft version. Includes a one-click Simple Voice Chat setup (mod/plugin + UDP port allocation + config + firewall). Nothing is changed automatically - you review and apply.
